stage1.impression: A handsome, well-proportioned deep room with plausible board-formed concrete, fir beams and a ribbed counter, but it reads as a good real-time-style render rather than a photograph. The hanging globe at the back reads as a neon LED wireframe or disco sphere, not as thick cast acrylic, and it pulls the room toward nightclub. The two wall screens read as bright white lightbox posters, hard street-lamp shadows rake the foreground floor like daylight, and the counter top is close to blown. As a specific place it is about two thirds of the way there: the altar pair, the record wall and the beams are specific, but the floor, the stools and the wall art still read as a generic catalogue bar.

blocking_9: Mother EARF's rims must read as glowing polished edges of thick tinted acrylic (a soft, saturated edge glow with the disc faces visible as tinted slabs), not as thin neon tubes. Rim p95 under 215, with the disc faces readable between the rims.
The banquette screens must glow softly at the level of the room, not as lightboxes: median 70 to 110, not 182.
Light must come from one coherent set of night practicals. No hard, bright, raking shadows from behind the camera on the foreground floor: floor median 30 to 55.
The altar pair must be the brightest read in the back zone and must read as smoked tinted acrylic: speaker regions median 55 or more.
The counter top must sit in pools under the Domes, not a continuous near-white strip: median under 120.
Atmosphere and signs of life in the foreground: a little visible haze in the Dome cones, and a glass or coat on the nearest table.
Material realism at 1:1: no smooth CG floor, no denoiser smear on the beams or the screens.

defects.what: Mother EARF reads as thin multicolour neon tubes or an LED wireframe globe. Rim highlights clip (3.5 %) and the 25 mm acrylic discs do not read as solid tinted slabs. Nightclub cue.
Large banquette screen is a flat, near-white lightbox (median 182) with a soft grey blob. It reads as a poster or signage and outshines everything else in the room.
Second screen is also too bright (median 132) for a night room.
Foreground floor is lit by hard, bright, radial shadows of stools cast from behind the camera (median 87, p95 190). It reads as daylight or a floodlight, not a night interior.
Counter top is a near-blown continuous strip (median 170, p95 242) instead of pools under the Domes.
Altar speakers read as pale grey boxes with grey woofers, under-lit (median 39 to 45), with no read of the smoked tint or light through the acrylic.
Banquette is crushed to near black (crush 15 %, b_median 6), with orange-brown colour cast in the shadows.
Fine chroma noise and a slightly smeary denoised look on the beams and the concrete. Edges are soft overall.
Three Orb lamps stacked in a vertical line in perspective read as repeated identical white balls. No glasses or life on the near tables.
Beams are uniformly orange (r_median 62 against b_median 16). The fir has no checks or darker end grain at 1:1.
